prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Pet Selection: Move sign-in step to occur after pet adoption selection so users build attachment before authenticating.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [adoption, redesign] Redesign Pet Picker Grid & Live Preview: Redesign the pet selection screen into a visual grid with clear choice cards.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion", "layout": "grid", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"action": "choose", "label": "Select Companion", "role": "pet_choices", "style": "playful", "type": "choice_cards"}]}}}
2: [home, new_screen] Desktop Verification Screen: Insert a desktop overlay setup check screen before final launch to verify window permissions.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_verify", "home_intro"], "waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Control Walkthrough: Add an interactive desktop control card list on the welcome screen showing hotkeys to hide, move, and talk to your pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Welcome! Here is How to Control Your Pet", "layout": "stage", "components": [{"style": "highlight", "text": "Press Alt+P to hide/show, click to pet, right-click for options", "type": "checklist"}]}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Safeguard Notice: Display a hint on the sign-in screen confirming existing cloud pets will be retained without resetting.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in will safely sync and retain your pets without resetting existing progress.", "show_progress": true}}
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Guidance Hint: Add bright image photo upload guidelines to prevent generation failures for custom pets.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload bright, front-facing photos for clear 3D desktop pet rendering.", "tip_delay_seconds": 5}}
6: [home, wait_info] Interactive Wait Screen Activity: Add a tip carousel and estimated time indicator to the waiting generation screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"style": "calm", "text": "Tips while your pet prepares...", "type": "tip_carousel"}], "show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 10}}
7: [choose_path, layout] Simplified Path Selection Cards: Change path choice layout to split cards clearly highlighting quick adoption vs custom creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"body": "Pick a ready-made companion or create a custom pet from your photos.", "headline": "How Would You Like to Start?", "layout": "split"}}
8: [home, notification] Ready Desktop System Notification: Add a desktop notification toggle when pet setup finishes loading in background.
   config: {"waiting": {"body": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet finishes loading!", "notify_when_ready": true}}
9: [finish, incentive] Adoption Certificate Mascot Celebration: Add a mascot celebration animation on the completion welcome screen before final desktop reveal.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"asset": "asset:celebration_mascot", "style": "playful", "type": "mascot"}], "headline": "Adoption Official!"}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering onboarding steps while preserving all required screens is explicitly allowed.
Redesigning the pet picker grid preserves the core function of selecting a pet.
Adding a new verification screen within onboarding is permitted.
Adding control instructions to the welcome home intro screen is allowed.
Adding a sync hint on the sign-in screen does not violate any onboarding rules.
Adding image upload guidance to the photo upload screen is allowed.
Adding a tip carousel and time estimate to the waiting screen is permitted.
Redesigning choose path layout while retaining options for ready-made and custom pets is allowed.
Adding a desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen is allowed.
Adding a mascot celebration component to the home intro screen is permitted.
